name: Hubbell
outlook:
What Hubbell says to expect

  • Full year 2026: sales growth and EPSFor the full year 2026, Hubbell anticipates total sales growth of 18-19%, including organic sales growth of 10-11%. Hubbell expects 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share in the range of $17.30 to $17.50 and adjusted diluted earnings per share (“Adjusted EPS”) in the range of $20.40 to $20.60.
  • Full year 2026: free cash flow conversionThe Company expects full year 2026 free cash flow conversion of approximately 90% on adjusted net income.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
